title: VPS
description: The server of the public site: host, the application's storage, Docker, monitoring (docs/monitoring.md, rows A, F9, B, G2).

list.name: Deployments
list.expr: count by (version) (findaline_build_info) unless count by (version) (findaline_build_info offset 5m)

panels.title: At a glance (A1-A8, B1, B2): red needs attention
CPU steal (A1)
panels.description: Time the hypervisor gave to the provider's other customers, mean of 5 min. Alert above 20 % for 15 min.

panels.title: Load per core (A1)
panels.description: 5-minute load divided by the cores; above 1 the CPU is queueing.

panels.title: Memory available (A2)
panels.description: Alert below 5 % for 5 min.

panels.title: OOM kills, 24 h (A2)
panels.description: Processes the kernel killed for lack of memory (host-wide, also inside containers). Alert on any.

panels.title: Free on /srv/docker (A3)
panels.description: Docker's data root: the site's data, runs and cache, and this monitoring. The site refuses searches below 20 GB; alert below 30 GB.

panels.title: Free on / (A3)
panels.description: Alert below 10 GB.

panels.title: /srv/docker full in (A3)
panels.description: Days until the disk is full at the rate of the last 7 days (linear).

panels.title: Disk image holes (A4)
panels.description: Unallocated parts of the disk image of --disk-image (host facts); vps.sh check fails above 1 GiB.

panels.title: Updates pending (A7)
panels.description: Packages with an update; unattended-upgrades installs the security ones every day.

panels.title: Clock offset (A8)
panels.description: chronyd's offset from NTP time. Alert above 1 s.

panels.title: web, worker (B1)
panels.description: web: its healthcheck; worker: running (it has no healthcheck). Alerts: not running, web unhealthy for 2 min.

panels.title: worker memory (B2)
panels.description: Of WORKER_MEMORY (without the page cache). Alert above 90 % for 5 min.

panels.title: Containers running
panels.description: All containers of the Docker host (the site's two and monitoring's four).

panels.title: Free disk and the 30-day forecast (A3)
panels.description: predict_linear over the last 7 days; dashed: the alert levels of / (10 GB) and /srv/docker (30 GB).

panels.title: Disk I/O: busy time (A5)
panels.description: Share of the time the device had requests in flight.

panels.title: Disk I/O: throughput (A5)
panels.description: Writes below the axis.

panels.title: Cache by folder (F9)
panels.description: Top-level folders of cache/, measured by the worker's housekeeping.

panels.title: Memory of the containers, % of their limit (B2)
CPU of the containers (B2)
panels.description: 100 % is one core.

panels.title: CPU throttling (B2)
panels.description: Periods per second in which a container hit its CPU limit.

panels.title: VictoriaMetrics data
panels.description: On /srv/docker (the volume findaline-monitoring_victoriametrics).
